name: Preservation
overview: Scripture reveals that God's Word is eternally preserved, pure, and unchanging, as seen in Psalms where His words are described as refined and established forever in heaven. The enduring nature of God's Word is emphasized in Isaiah, affirming that unlike the fleeting grass and flowers, His Word stands forever. Christ Himself affirms the vital sustenance found in every word from God's mouth, highlighting its life-giving and preserving power. Moreover, God's Word is exalted above all, demonstrating its supreme authority and faithful preservation throughout all generations.
